The '''Mining Outpost''' was a settlement on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin IV]].

==Characteristics==
The outpost was little more than a small, enclosed settlement. Some notable structures within the confines of the outpost included a small [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]], medical center, and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="AED" />

==History==
This outpost was established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after they captured Yavin IV from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="AED" />

Some notabe residents of the outpost during this time included [[Gardo Valdell]], [[Jazeen Thurmm]], [[Breac Slaus]], [[Osae Meilea]], [[Zelma]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Verks]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mining Outpost is one of three small outposts on Yavin IV in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' that has its own spaceport. The other two settlements that have a spaceport in the game are the [[Labor Outpost]] and the [[Imperial Fortress (Yavin 4)|Imperial Fortress]].
